description: This file defines the HealthStore class and related data structures used for monitoring the health status of a networked service within the OpenClaw application. It includes data models for health snapshots, status enums, and logic for polling, decoding, and interpreting health data.

classes.name: HealthStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for maintaining and updating the health status of the application, including polling for health data, decoding responses, and providing status summaries.

methods.name: __setSnapshotForTest
methods.description: Test-only method to set the health snapshot and error state manually for testing purposes.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the periodic health polling task.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Performs an on-demand refresh of the health data, decoding the response and updating internal state.

methods.name: isChannelHealthy
methods.description: Determines if a given channel summary indicates a healthy state.

methods.name: describeProbeFailure
methods.description: Generates a human-readable description of a failed health probe.

methods.name: resolveLinkChannel
methods.description: Resolves the currently linked health channel from the snapshot.

methods.name: resolveFallbackChannel
methods.description: Finds a healthy fallback channel excluding a specified channel from the snapshot.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the failure state based on the snapshot.
